candidates.change_summary: Remove the require overflow check on balances update, which can cause silent overflows that revert in the original but proceed in the mutant.
Change the deposit condition from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit, altering the behavior when exactly MinDeposit is sent.
Replace balances[msg.sender] with a different address in the balance update, causing the deposit to affect a fixed address instead of the caller.
Replace the require safety check with require(false), making all deposits revert that would otherwise succeed above the threshold.
Delete the entire if guard so deposit always updates balance regardless of msg.value, changing balances for deposits <= MinDeposit.
